evidence.raw: This program is available to international applicants who will complete the program from outside Canada or who currently have a valid work permit in Canada that will be valid for the duration of clinical training. Study permit: International applicants accepted into this program are not eligible for a study permit. Post-graduation Work Permit (PGWP) eligibility : While this program currently meets the study program - graduates with a bachelor’s degree criteria to apply for a PGWP, this program is not eligible for a PGWP due to other criteria not being met. There are no field of study requirements (CIP) for graduates with a bachelor’s degree. International students must receive program head approval before applying.
